## How it was checked

## Safety

- [ ] No keys, passwords, setup codes, private addresses, real conversations or
      signing material in the diff, the screenshots or the description
- [ ] No new permission, dependency, endpoint, analytics or cleartext exception
      (or it is explained and reviewed)
- [ ] Third-party notices are preserved, and new third-party material says where it comes from and under which license
